meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 装上后，它会安装 @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard 并给 NanoClaw 加一个本地监控仪表盘，展示 agent 组、会话、频道、用户、token 用量、上下文窗口和实时日志，由一个推送器定期发送 JSON 快照。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加本地监控仪表盘，或执行 /add-dashboard 时触发；它还要求配置 DASHBOARD_SECRET 等环境变量。

howto.what_en: Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and adds a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw: agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows and real-time logs, fed by a pusher that sends JSON snapshots.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, or when /add-dashboard is invoked; it also needs DASHBOARD_SECRET and related env vars set.
